Replace only image1's entire old tail with the same moderate fluffy white tail and natural hanging pose as image2. Copy the reference's DEPTH AND CLOTH OCCLUSION, not just its curve.
The tail passes through the established hidden rear dress opening and stays outside the BACK of the skirt. In this front view the true base and the whole upstream section are INVISIBLE behind the body and solid skirt. Only the MIDDLE and DISTAL tail are visible after clearing the LOWER SIDE skirt contour on viewer-right. The cloth/ruffle edge is unmistakably IN FRONT of the upstream tail; tail outlines disappear behind that cloth edge rather than ending in a point or a cut surface. No hole on front, side or hem.
Remove any visible tail beside a sleeve/cuff, upper skirt, waist bow, palm or long hair. NEVER expose a tubular proximal section next to an arm. No tail beside or between thighs that looks like it grows from a leg. Keep a readable background gap from legs. One tail only, complete continuous visible silhouette, no floating segment.
For this pose adjust the occluding point to its actual skirt position rather than blindly copying pixel coordinates. The tail's true attachment is intentionally hidden; do not force it into view.
